+The `skip` function is used for skipping the first number of elements. For example if the message body is a `List` with
+the values `a,b,c` then `${skip(1)}` returns an `Iterator` over `b,c`. It works on a `List`, an array or an `Iterator`.
+A `String` body is split on commas, not on lines: to skip the header line of a CSV text, use the
+xref:tokenize-language.adoc[Tokenize] language with `skipFirst`, or the xref:dataformats:csv-dataformat.adoc[CSV] data format.
The `split` function is as the name implies used for splitting the message body or the value (using a separator) into an array of sub elements.

=== About rejected tasks
The Threads EIP uses a thread pool which has a worker queue for tasks.
-When the worker queue gets full, the task is rejected.
+When the worker queue is full, the pool starts more threads, up to `maxPoolSize`.
+When the queue is full and the pool has `maxPoolSize` threads, the task is rejected.
You can customize how to react upon this using the `rejectedPolicy` and
